en: A large crowd follows Jesus across the Sea of Galilee because of the signs he does for the sick.
Jesus asks Philip where they can buy bread; Philip says two hundred denarii would not be enough.
Andrew points to a boy with five barley loaves and two fish.
Jesus has the people sit on the grass, about five thousand men.
He gives thanks and distributes the bread and fish, as much as they want.
The disciples gather the leftover pieces and fill twelve baskets.
The people say he is the Prophet; Jesus withdraws when they want to make him king.
zh: 一大群人因為看見耶穌醫治病人的神蹟，就跟着他到加利利海的對岸。
耶穌問腓力要從哪裏買餅；腓力說兩百個銀幣買餅也不夠。
安得烈指出有一個小孩子帶着五個大麥餅和兩條魚。
耶穌叫眾人坐在草地上，男人約有五千。
他祝謝了，就把餅和魚分給眾人，大家要多少就給多少。
門徒把剩下的碎塊收拾起來，裝滿了十二個籃子。
眾人說他就是那位先知；他們要強逼他作王，耶穌就退到山上去了。

about.en: Matthew's account of the feeding
about.zh: 馬太記載的五餅二魚

about.en: Elisha feeds a hundred men with twenty loaves
about.zh: 以利沙用二十個餅餵飽一百人

about.en: Jesus says, I am the bread of life
about.zh: 耶穌說他就是生命的糧

about.en: God gives Israel manna in the wilderness
about.zh: 神在曠野賜嗎哪給以色列人

en: The Sea of Galilee is a freshwater lake about 21 km long and 13 km wide, lying about 210 m below sea level.
Herod Antipas founded the city of Tiberias on its western shore about AD 20, so the lake was also called the Sea of Tiberias.
A denarius was about a day's wage for a laborer (Matthew 20:2). Barley bread was the common food of the poor.
Apart from the resurrection, this is the only miracle of Jesus told in all four Gospels.
zh: 加利利海是淡水湖，長約21公里，寬約13公里，湖面低於海平面約210公尺。
希律安提帕約在主後20年在湖的西岸建了提比哩亞城，所以這湖又叫提比哩亞海。
一個銀幣（第納流斯）約是工人一天的工資（馬太福音20章2節）。大麥餅是窮人的日常食物。
除了復活以外，這是四本福音書都有記載的唯一神蹟。

en: Jesus sends the disciples ahead by boat and goes up the mountain alone to pray.
Far from land, the boat is battered by waves because the wind is against them.
Shortly before dawn Jesus comes to them, walking on the sea; they cry out, thinking he is a ghost.
Jesus says, Take courage! It is I. Don't be afraid.
Peter walks on the water toward Jesus, but seeing the wind he is afraid and begins to sink.
Jesus catches him and asks why he doubted.
The wind dies down, and those in the boat worship him as the Son of God.
zh: 耶穌叫門徒先坐船過去，自己獨自上山禱告。
船離岸很遠，因為逆風，被風浪打得顛簸。
天快亮的時候，耶穌在海面上走向他們；他們以為是鬼怪，就驚叫起來。
耶穌說：「放心！是我，不要怕。」
彼得在水面上走向耶穌，但看見風大就害怕，開始往下沉。
耶穌拉住他，問他為甚麼疑惑。
風就停了，船上的人都拜他，說他真是神的兒子。

about.en: Mark's account of Jesus walking on the sea
about.zh: 馬可記載耶穌在海面上行走

about.en: John's account, after the feeding
about.zh: 約翰的記載，在五餅二魚之後

about.en: God treads on the waves of the sea
about.zh: 神踐踏海浪

about.en: The LORD calms the storm for sailors
about.zh: 耶和華為航海的人平息風浪

en: Winds descending from the hills around the Sea of Galilee can raise sudden, violent storms on the lake.
In 1986 a fishing boat about 8 m long, dated to about the time of Jesus, was found in the mud near Ginosar on the lake's shore.
A stadion, the distance in verse 24, was about 185 m.
zh: 從加利利海四周山上吹下來的風，常在湖上掀起突如其來的猛烈風浪。
1986年，人們在湖邊吉諾薩附近的泥中發現一艘約8公尺長的漁船，年代約在耶穌的時代。
第24節的「斯塔迪亞」是希臘的長度單位，一斯塔迪約185公尺。

en: Jesus is teaching in a synagogue on the Sabbath.
A woman has been bent over for eighteen years and cannot stand up straight.
Jesus says she is set free, lays his hands on her, and she stands up and praises God.
The synagogue leader tells the crowd to come for healing on the six work days, not the Sabbath.
Jesus answers that they untie an ox or donkey on the Sabbath to give it water.
He asks whether this daughter of Abraham should not be set free on the Sabbath.
His opponents are put to shame, and the crowd rejoices.
zh: 耶穌在安息日在一個會堂裏教導人。
有一個女人駝背十八年，一點也直不起腰來。
耶穌說她得了釋放，把手按在她身上，她立刻直起腰來，讚美神。
會堂主管對眾人說，應該在六天做工的日子來求醫治，不要在安息日。
耶穌回答說，他們在安息日也解開牛和驢，牽去喝水。
他問：這個亞伯拉罕的女兒難道不應該在安息日得釋放嗎？
反對他的人都慚愧，眾人卻都歡喜。

about.en: The Sabbath commandment
about.zh: 安息日的誡命

about.en: Jesus heals a man's withered hand on the Sabbath
about.zh: 耶穌在安息日醫好一隻萎縮的手

about.en: The Sabbath was made for people
about.zh: 安息日是為人設立的

about.en: Jesus heals a man on the Sabbath at a Pharisee's house
about.zh: 耶穌在法利賽人家裏於安息日治病

en: The Jewish Sabbath runs from sunset on Friday to sunset on Saturday.
Synagogues from the first century have been excavated at Magdala, Gamla and Masada; they had benches along the walls facing the center.
The Mishnah, a collection of Jewish law written down about AD 200, lists thirty-nine kinds of work forbidden on the Sabbath.
zh: 猶太人的安息日從星期五日落開始，到星期六日落結束。
考古學家在抹大拉、迦姆拉和馬撒大發掘出第一世紀的會堂，牆邊都有面向中間的石凳。
約在主後200年寫成的猶太律法彙編《米示拿》，列出了安息日禁止的三十九類工作。

title.en: The parable of the mustard seed

en: Jesus tells another parable about the kingdom of heaven.
The kingdom is like a mustard seed that a man sows in his field.
It is the smallest of all seeds.
When it has grown, it is the largest of garden plants and becomes a tree.
The birds of the sky come and nest in its branches; Mark says, in its shade.
zh: 耶穌又講了一個關於天國的比喻。
天國好比一粒芥菜種，有人拿來種在自己的田裏。
它比一切的種子都小。
長起來以後，卻比一切蔬菜都大，成了一棵樹。
天空的飛鳥都來在它的枝子上棲息；馬可說是在它的蔭下。

about.en: Luke's telling of the mustard seed
about.zh: 路加記載的芥菜種比喻

about.en: A cedar where birds of every kind nest
about.zh: 各類飛鳥棲息的香柏樹

about.en: Nebuchadnezzar dreams of a great tree
about.zh: 尼布甲尼撒夢見一棵大樹

about.en: The parable of the yeast
about.zh: 麵酵的比喻

en: Black mustard grows wild in Galilee; in a season it can grow to about 3 m tall.
A mustard seed is about 1 mm across. Jewish sayings of the time used it as a picture of something very small.
Matthew 13 gathers seven parables of the kingdom, beginning with the parable of the sower.
zh: 黑芥菜在加利利野地生長，一季可長到約3公尺高。
芥菜種直徑約1公釐。當時猶太人的俗語常用它來比喻極小的東西。
馬太福音第13章收集了七個天國的比喻，以撒種的比喻開始。

en: An expert in the Law asks Jesus what he must do to inherit eternal life.
He answers from the Law: love God with all your heart, and your neighbor as yourself.
He asks, Who is my neighbor? Jesus tells of a man beaten by robbers on the road to Jericho.
A priest and a Levite see him and pass by on the other side.
A Samaritan has compassion, bandages his wounds, and takes him to an inn.
He pays the innkeeper two denarii and promises to repay any more he spends.
The lawyer says the neighbor was the one who showed mercy; Jesus says, Go and do the same.
zh: 一個律法教師問耶穌，他該做甚麼才可以承受永生。
他引用律法回答：要全心愛主你的神，又要愛鄰舍如同自己。
他問：「誰是我的鄰舍呢？」耶穌講了一個人在往耶利哥的路上被強盜打傷的故事。
一個祭司和一個利未人看見了他，都從另一邊走過去了。
一個撒馬利亞人動了憐憫的心，替他包紮傷口，帶他到旅店裏去。
他給店主兩個銀幣，又答應回來時償還多用的費用。
律法教師說，是憐憫他的那一位；耶穌說：「你去照樣做吧。」

about.en: Love the LORD your God with all your heart
about.zh: 要全心愛耶和華你的神

about.en: Love your neighbor as yourself
about.zh: 要愛鄰舍如同自己

about.en: Jesus asks a Samaritan woman for a drink
about.zh: 耶穌向撒馬利亞婦人要水喝

about.en: Men of Samaria care for captives from Judah
about.zh: 撒馬利亞人照顧猶大的俘虜

en: The road from Jerusalem, about 750 m above sea level, drops about 1,000 m to Jericho in some 27 km of desert.
Samaritans worshiped on Mount Gerizim, not in Jerusalem; a small Samaritan community still lives near Nablus today.
Oil and wine were common remedies for wounds; two denarii were about two days' wages.
zh: 耶路撒冷海拔約750公尺；往耶利哥的路穿過曠野，約27公里，下降約1000公尺。
撒馬利亞人在基利心山敬拜，不在耶路撒冷；今天仍有一小群撒馬利亞人住在納布盧斯附近。
油和酒是當時常用來處理傷口的東西；兩個銀幣約是兩天的工資。

en: The younger of two sons asks for his share of the property and wastes it in a distant country.
In a famine he feeds pigs and longs to eat their carob pods.
He comes to his senses and goes home to say, Father, I have sinned.
While he is still far off, his father runs to him, embraces him and kisses him.
The father gives him the best robe, a ring and sandals, and holds a feast.
The older son is angry and will not go in.
The father says, Your brother was dead and has come to life; he was lost and is found.
zh: 兩個兒子中的小兒子要了他應得的家產，到遠方去揮霍淨盡。
遇上饑荒，他去放豬，恨不得拿豬吃的豆莢充飢。
他醒悟過來，就回家去，要說：「父親，我得罪了你。」
他離家還遠，父親就看見他，跑去抱着他，連連親他。
父親給他穿上上好的袍子，戴上戒指，穿上鞋，又擺設筵席。
大兒子卻生氣，不肯進去。
父親說：「你這個弟弟是死而復活，失而又得的。」

about.en: Pharisees grumble that Jesus eats with sinners
about.zh: 法利賽人埋怨耶穌和罪人吃飯

about.en: The parable of the lost sheep
about.zh: 迷羊的比喻

about.en: The parable of the lost coin
about.zh: 失錢的比喻

about.en: As a father has compassion on his children
about.zh: 父親怎樣憐恤兒女

en: Under the Law the firstborn received a double share (Deuteronomy 21:17), so a younger of two sons would receive one third.
Pigs were unclean animals under the Law (Leviticus 11:7), so feeding them was a degrading job for a Jew.
Carob pods, from a tree common around the Mediterranean, were used as animal feed and eaten by the very poor.
zh: 按照律法，長子得雙份（申命記21章17節），所以兩個兒子中的小兒子得三分之一。
按照律法豬是不潔的動物（利未記11章7節），對猶太人來說，放豬是很低賤的工作。
豆莢是地中海一帶常見的角豆樹的果實，通常用來餵牲口，極窮的人也拿來吃。

en: A rich man dresses in purple and fine linen and lives in luxury every day.
At his gate lies a poor man named Lazarus, covered with sores, longing for scraps from his table.
Lazarus dies and is carried by angels to Abraham's side; the rich man dies and is in torment in Hades.
The rich man begs Abraham to send Lazarus to cool his tongue.
Abraham says a great chasm lies between them that no one can cross.
The rich man asks that Lazarus warn his five brothers.
Abraham says if they will not listen to Moses and the Prophets, they will not be convinced even by one who rises from the dead.
zh: 有一個財主穿着紫色袍和細麻衣，天天奢華宴樂。
他門口躺着一個名叫拉撒路的窮人，滿身是瘡，想吃財主桌上掉下來的東西。
拉撒路死了，被天使帶到亞伯拉罕的懷裏；財主也死了，在陰間受痛苦。
財主求亞伯拉罕打發拉撒路來涼涼他的舌頭。
亞伯拉罕說，他們中間有深淵隔開，誰也過不去。
財主又求叫拉撒路去警告他的五個兄弟。
亞伯拉罕說，若不聽摩西和先知的話，就是有人從死裏復活，他們也不會信服。

about.en: You cannot serve God and money
about.zh: 你們不能又事奉神又事奉錢財

about.en: Open your hand to the poor
about.zh: 要向窮人鬆開你的手

about.en: Leaders plot to kill the risen Lazarus of Bethany
about.zh: 祭司長圖謀殺死復活的拉撒路

about.en: Moses and the Prophets speak of the Messiah
about.zh: 摩西和眾先知所寫關於基督的話

en: Purple dye came from murex sea snails off the coast of Phoenicia; it was so costly that purple cloth marked the very rich.
Hades is the Greek word used for the realm of the dead; the Old Testament's Hebrew word is Sheol.
Lazarus is the Greek form of the Hebrew name Eleazar, meaning God helps. He is the only person given a name in Jesus' parables.
zh: 紫色染料取自腓尼基沿海的骨螺，價錢極高，紫色衣料是富豪的記號。
「陰間」希臘文是「哈得斯」，指死人所在的地方；舊約希伯來文用「示阿勒」。
拉撒路是希伯來名字以利亞撒的希臘寫法，意思是「神幫助」。他是耶穌比喻中唯一有名字的人物。

en: Mary and Martha send word that their brother Lazarus is ill; Jesus stays two more days.
When Jesus reaches Bethany, Lazarus has been in the tomb four days.
Jesus tells Martha, I am the resurrection and the life; she believes he is the Messiah, the Son of God.
Seeing Mary and the others weeping, Jesus is deeply moved, and he weeps.
At the tomb he has the stone taken away, thanks the Father, and calls, Lazarus, come out!
Lazarus comes out bound in grave cloths, and many believe in Jesus.
The high priest Caiaphas says one man should die for the people; from then on they plan to kill Jesus.
zh: 馬利亞和馬大派人告訴耶穌，她們的兄弟拉撒路病了；耶穌又停留了兩天。
耶穌到了伯大尼，拉撒路已經在墳墓裏四天了。
耶穌對馬大說：「我就是復活，就是生命。」她信他是基督，是神的兒子。
耶穌看見馬利亞和眾人哭，心裏非常激動，也流淚了。
他在墳墓前叫人挪開石頭，感謝父，然後大聲呼叫：「拉撒路，出來！」
拉撒路裹着布條出來了，許多人就信了耶穌。
大祭司該亞法說一個人替百姓死是好的；從那天起，他們就計劃殺耶穌。

about.en: A dinner for Jesus in Bethany with Lazarus
about.zh: 在伯大尼為耶穌擺設的筵席，拉撒路也在

about.en: Elijah raises a widow's son
about.zh: 以利亞使寡婦的兒子復活

about.en: Jesus raises a widow's son at Nain
about.zh: 耶穌在拿因城使寡婦的兒子復活

about.en: Christ, the firstfruits of those who have died
about.zh: 基督成為睡了之人初熟的果子

en: Bethany is the Arab town of al-Eizariya, on the east slope of the Mount of Olives; its name comes from Lazarus. It is about 3 km from Jerusalem.
Tombs of this period were cut into the rock and closed with a large stone; bodies were wrapped in linen strips with spices.
Caiaphas was high priest about AD 18 to 36. An ossuary inscribed Joseph son of Caiaphas was found in Jerusalem in 1990.
zh: 伯大尼就是今天的阿拉伯城鎮艾薩里亞，在橄欖山東坡，名字來自拉撒路，離耶路撒冷約3公里。
這時期的墳墓是在岩石中鑿成的，用大石頭封口；屍體用細麻布條裹好，加上香料。
該亞法約在主後18年至36年任大祭司。1990年在耶路撒冷發現一個刻有「該亞法之子約瑟」的骨灰箱。

en: Jesus sits opposite the temple treasury and watches the crowd put in money.
Many rich people put in large amounts.
A poor widow puts in two small copper coins, worth a fraction of a penny.
Jesus calls his disciples and says she has put in more than all the others.
They gave out of their abundance; she gave out of her poverty everything she had to live on.
zh: 耶穌對着聖殿的銀庫坐着，看眾人怎樣把錢投進去。
有好些財主投了很多錢。
有一個窮寡婦來了，投了兩個小銅錢，就是一個羅馬小錢。
耶穌叫門徒來，說她投的比眾人投的都多。
他們是從自己的富餘中拿出來，她卻是從不足中，把她一切養生的都投上了。

about.en: Luke's account of the widow's offering
about.zh: 路加記載寡婦的奉獻

about.en: Jesus warns against scribes who devour widows' houses
about.zh: 耶穌警告那侵吞寡婦家產的文士

about.en: The Macedonians give out of deep poverty
about.zh: 馬其頓的教會在極度貧窮中慷慨捐獻

about.en: A poor widow of Zarephath feeds Elijah
about.zh: 撒勒法的窮寡婦供養以利亞

en: Herod the Great began rebuilding the temple about 20 BC; the work went on for decades.
The Mishnah describes thirteen trumpet-shaped offering chests in the temple courts.
The widow's coins were lepta, the smallest Jewish coins; two made a Roman quadrans, one sixty-fourth of a denarius.
zh: 大希律約在主前20年開始重建聖殿，工程延續了幾十年。
《米示拿》記載聖殿院子裏有十三個喇叭形的奉獻箱。
寡婦投的是「利普頓」，最小的猶太銅幣；兩個等於一個羅馬「誇德蘭」，即一個銀幣的六十四分之一。

en: Near Bethphage and Bethany at the Mount of Olives, Jesus sends two disciples ahead.
They are to bring a colt no one has ridden, saying, The Lord needs it.
They find the colt as he said, and the people let them take it.
They throw cloaks on it, and Jesus sits on it.
Many spread cloaks and leafy branches on the road.
The crowds shout, Hosanna! Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord!
Jesus enters the temple, looks around, and goes out to Bethany with the Twelve.
zh: 到了橄欖山附近的伯法其和伯大尼，耶穌派了兩個門徒先去。
他們要牽來一匹從來沒有人騎過的驢駒，說：「主要用牠。」
他們照耶穌所說的找到了驢駒，旁人也讓他們牽走。
他們把衣服搭在驢駒上，耶穌就騎上去。
許多人把衣服鋪在路上，也有人把田間砍下的樹枝鋪在路上。
眾人喊着說：「和散那！奉主名來的是應當稱頌的！」
耶穌進了聖殿，周圍看了看，就和十二門徒出城往伯大尼去了。

about.en: Your king comes, humble and riding on a donkey
about.zh: 你的王謙和地騎着驢來到

about.en: Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the LORD
about.zh: 奉耶和華名來的是應當稱頌的

about.en: Crowds take palm branches to meet Jesus
about.zh: 眾人拿着棕樹枝出來迎接耶穌

about.en: The next day Jesus clears the temple
about.zh: 第二天耶穌潔淨聖殿

en: The Mount of Olives rises east of Jerusalem across the Kidron Valley, about 800 m high; the road from Jericho crossed it.
Hosanna comes from the Hebrew of Psalm 118:25, meaning Save, please.
At Passover, pilgrims from across the land and beyond filled Jerusalem many times over its usual population.
Jesus' death is usually dated to AD 30 or 33.
zh: 橄欖山在耶路撒冷東邊，隔着汲淪谷，高約800公尺；從耶利哥來的路要經過這山。
「和散那」源自詩篇118篇25節的希伯來文，意思是「求你拯救」。
逾越節期間，各地來的朝聖者擠滿耶路撒冷，人數是平時的好幾倍。
耶穌受死的年份一般定在主後30年或33年。

title.en: The Lord's Supper; Jesus washes his disciples' feet
title.zh: 主的晚餐；耶穌為門徒洗腳

en: Jesus sends Peter and John to prepare the Passover in a large upstairs room.
At the meal Jesus says he has eagerly desired to eat this Passover with them before he suffers.
He takes bread, gives thanks, breaks it and says, This is my body given for you.
After supper he takes the cup: This cup is the new covenant in my blood.
In John, Jesus ties a towel around his waist and washes the disciples' feet.
Peter refuses, then asks Jesus to wash his hands and head too.
Jesus says, I have given you an example: wash one another's feet.
zh: 耶穌派彼得和約翰在一間寬大的樓房裏預備逾越節的筵席。
吃飯時耶穌說，他很渴望在受害以前和他們吃這逾越節的筵席。
他拿起餅來，祝謝了，擘開，說：「這是我的身體，為你們捨的。」
晚飯以後，他拿起杯來說：「這杯是用我的血所立的新約。」
約翰記載，耶穌把毛巾束在腰間，為門徒洗腳。
彼得起先不肯，後來又求耶穌連手和頭也洗。
耶穌說：「我給你們立了榜樣，你們也應當彼此洗腳。」

about.en: The first Passover in Egypt
about.zh: 在埃及的第一個逾越節

about.en: God promises a new covenant
about.zh: 神應許要立新約

about.en: Paul hands on the words of the Lord's Supper
about.zh: 保羅傳下主的晚餐的話

about.en: Mark's account of the bread and the cup
about.zh: 馬可記載的餅和杯

en: The Passover meal remembered the exodus from Egypt; the lamb was sacrificed at the temple on the afternoon of 14 Nisan.
At festive meals people reclined on cushions or couches around a low table, leaning on the left elbow.
Washing guests' feet, dusty from sandals and unpaved roads, was usually a servant's task.
Tradition places the upper room on Mount Zion; the present Cenacle building there dates from the Crusader period.
zh: 逾越節的筵席是記念出埃及；羔羊在尼散月十四日下午在聖殿宰殺。
在節期的筵席上，人們斜靠在矮桌旁的墊子或榻上，用左肘支撐身體。
人穿涼鞋走泥路，腳很髒；為客人洗腳通常是僕人的工作。
傳統認為那樓房在錫安山上；那裏現存的「最後晚餐廳」建於十字軍時期。

en: Pilate finds no basis for a charge, but the crowd shouts, Crucify him! and he hands Jesus over.
At the place called the Skull Jesus is crucified between two criminals and says, Father, forgive them.
He promises one criminal, Today you will be with me in paradise.
Darkness covers the land, the temple veil is torn, and Jesus commits his spirit to the Father and dies.
Joseph of Arimathea lays his body in a new rock-cut tomb.
On the first day of the week the women find the tomb empty; two men say, He has been raised.
Jesus appears to the disciples, eats fish before them, and is carried up into heaven at Bethany.
zh: 彼拉多查不出耶穌有罪，但眾人喊着「釘他十字架！」，他就把耶穌交給他們。
耶穌在名叫「髑髏地」的地方，和兩個犯人一同被釘十字架；他說：「父啊，赦免他們。」
他對其中一個犯人說：「今天你要和我一同在樂園裏了。」
遍地黑暗，聖殿的幔子裂開，耶穌把靈魂交在父手裏，就斷了氣。
亞利馬太人約瑟把他的身體安放在新鑿的石墓裏。
七日的第一日，婦女們發現墳墓空了；兩個人對她們說：「他已經復活了。」
耶穌向門徒顯現，在他們面前吃魚，後來在伯大尼被接到天上去。

about.en: He was counted among the rebels
about.zh: 他被列在罪犯之中

about.en: They divide my clothes and cast lots for my garment
about.zh: 他們分了我的外衣，為我的內衣抽籤

about.en: Jesus meets two disciples on the road to Emmaus
about.zh: 耶穌在往以馬忤斯的路上遇見兩個門徒

about.en: Christ died, was buried and was raised
about.zh: 基督死了，埋葬了，又復活了

en: Pontius Pilate governed Judea about AD 26 to 36. A stone inscription naming him prefect of Judea was found at Caesarea in 1961.
Crucifixion was a Roman punishment for slaves and rebels. A heel bone pierced by an iron nail was found in a Jerusalem tomb in 1968.
Since the 4th century the Church of the Holy Sepulchre has been the traditional site of the cross and tomb; some prefer the Garden Tomb.
zh: 本丟彼拉多約在主後26年至36年治理猶太。1961年在該撒利亞發現一塊刻有他名字和「猶太總督」頭銜的石碑。
釘十字架是羅馬人懲罰奴隸和叛亂者的刑罰。1968年在耶路撒冷一個墳墓裏發現一塊被鐵釘穿透的腳跟骨。
從第四世紀起，聖墓教堂一直是傳統上釘十字架和埋葬的地點；也有人認為是「花園塚」。
